brief:
Israeli occupation forces entered the eastern section of Nablus in the northern West Bank on Sunday morning, deploying across multiple streets in the area, Shehab Wire reported. The incursion coincided with a tightening of military procedures against residents throughout the city.

Soldiers established a military checkpoint on the eastern side of Nablus as part of the operation. The deployment marked the latest in a series of raids conducted by Israeli forces in Palestinian population centers across the occupied territory.
